description.value: The Lakeview Store has been a grocery anchor on the remote east shore of Kootenay Lake since the early 1940s, operating as part of the larger Kootenay Lakeview resort complex. It offers a surprisingly full selection including fresh produce, specialty cheeses, organic and bulk foods, a rural liquor agency, and espresso drinks made from locally roasted beans. Lakeshore picnic tables make it a natural stop for cyclists travelling the scenic Highway 3A corridor, which is rated the number one motorcycle road in southern BC.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for kootenaylakeview.com is an active, detailed site confirming this is a real resort and store on Highway 3A in Gray Creek. The /store/ page confirms a fully stocked grocery store with espresso drinks, fresh sandwiches, samosas and sausage rolls, liquor, and gas (matching OSM amenity=fuel). No explicit mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or bike-specific amenities is found anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM name is 'Lakeview Store' but the brand name used throughout the website is 'Kootenay Lakeview'; the store is one component of a larger resort property. OSM name retained per rules.
OSM amenity=fuel confirmed as vehicle gasoline/diesel; no evidence of camping fuel (propane/butane) sold separately.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active grocery store and resort complex on a remote stretch of Highway 3A — a practical and notable resupply stop for touring cyclists on the east shore of Kootenay Lake.
enrichment_extras.notes: The resort also offers R.V. and tent camping, full amenity suites, rustic accommodations, and a 14-slip marina — relevant context for cycle-tourers seeking overnight options in this remote area.

Basic groceries.detail: Website describes a fully stocked grocery store with fresh produce, specialty cheeses, organic and bulk foods, fresh bread, canned and frozen foods, and seasonal local products

Hot food.detail: Store page lists samosas and sausage rolls, fresh sandwiches, and espresso drinks (latte, americano, cappuccino, espresso shots) made from locally roasted beans
